description: This source file implements the AddressInfo class and related functions for DNS address resolution within the Chromium project's net namespace. It handles address lookup, iteration over address info, and conversion to address lists.

classes.name: AddressInfo
classes.description: Represents DNS address information, providing iteration, address list creation, and hostname resolution.

classes.name: AddressInfo::const_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing addrinfo linked list.

classes.name: AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Encapsulates system call to get address info, supporting network-specific lookups.

methods.name: AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs DNS address resolution for a hostname with hints and optional network handle.

methods.name: AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Converts AddressInfo into an AddressList object.

methods.name: AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname if available.

methods.name: AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addresses are localhost addresses of the same family.
